author: Hank Green
description:
Honestly, glad to have taken a little breather so I could finally finish this video, which I've been working on for at least two years!! Thanks so much to Keith Moore at the Royal Society and Spencer Weinreich (who is a historian of prisons!!) for taking the time to chat with me so I could get deeper into this story.
